summary: Ram arrives at a dockside gathering where his friends playfully interrogate him about his night, and he poetically hints at his rendezvous with Leela.
setting: A boat/harbor dock gathering area in Gujarat, filled with men drinking and relaxing.

register_note: Colloquial Gujarati Hindi blend ('छोकरी कौन छे', 'कमाल छे', 'बवाल छे') with fraternal terms of endearment and respect ('राम भाई', 'कानजी भाई', 'बेटा', 'यार').
expected_translation_notes: Use informal peer forms (machan/thambi in Tamil, macha/bava in Telugu, bhau/dost in Marathi). Gujarati markers like 'छे' should map to playful localized tag words or colloquial copulas.
